description: This file contains the Vietnamese language localization strings for the Select2 plugin version 4.0.6-rc.1. It defines various user interface messages used within the plugin for Vietnamese users.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the user has input enough or too many characters, in Vietnamese.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the user needs to input more characters, in Vietnamese.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns a message indicating more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the maximum number of selections allowed.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns a message indicating no search results were found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that a search is in progress.
